description: Remote worker unable to establish secure IPSec/TLS tunnel or experiencing frequent gateway disconnects on GlobalProtect/Cisco AnyConnect.
example_user_phrases: Can't connect to VPN from home
GlobalProtect keeps timing out after 2FA auth
VPN gateway disconnects every 5 minutes

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Can you access public websites (e.g., google.com) without the VPN active?

options.label: No, local Wi-Fi / internet is completely down

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Which regional VPN gateway are you trying to connect to?

troubleshooting_steps: Verify home internet connectivity outside VPN.
Execute local DNS cache flush command (`ipconfig /flushdns` or `sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder`).
Switch connection gateway in VPN client to US-West fallback.
Re-authenticate MFA auth token.

p3_conditions: Single user home Wi-Fi MTU issue

escalation_conditions: Gateway server unreachable for over 15 minutes

description: Device connected to Enterprise Wi-Fi SSID but failing 802.1X certificate authentication or missing web captive portal prompt.
example_user_phrases: Connected to Enterprise Wi-Fi but no internet
Captive portal page won't load
Wi-Fi keeps asking for password

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Which Wi-Fi network are you attempting to connect to?

troubleshooting_steps: Forget network profile and reconnect to trigger fresh 802.1X authentication.
Navigate to http://1.1.1.1 or http://neverssl.com to force captive portal redirect.
Renew DHCP IP lease.

p1_conditions: Entire floor wireless access point outage

description: User account locked in Active Directory / OKTA due to repeated incorrect password attempts or expired credentials.
example_user_phrases: My account is locked
I forgot my SSO password
Too many failed login attempts error

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Is the login failure locking your primary corporate SSO or a single third-party tool?
What message appears on your login screen?

options.label: Account locked due to multiple failed attempts

troubleshooting_steps: Navigate to Enterprise Self-Service Password Reset Portal (id.enterprise.com/reset).
Wait 15 minutes for automatic AD account lock expiration.
Verify cached credentials on secondary mobile devices are updated.

p1_conditions: VIP Executive locked out before press release

description: User not receiving 2FA push notifications on Authenticator App or TOTP passcode rejected.
example_user_phrases: Not getting Okta verify push notification
MFA code says invalid or expired
I got a new phone and lost my authenticator

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Did you recently replace or reset your mobile device?

options.label: Yes, new phone without restored authenticator
No, same phone but push notifications not arriving

troubleshooting_steps: Toggle Airplane mode on mobile phone to refresh push notification connection.
Check time synchronization settings on mobile phone (Date & Time -> Automatic).
Use backup SMS or temporary bypass code issued by IT Desk.

p1_conditions: Executive unable to authorize emergency change

escalation_conditions: Okta / Duo tenant push service outage

description: Microsoft Outlook desktop client stuck in 'Disconnected' or 'Trying to connect' state, or inbox failing to sync new mail.
example_user_phrases: Outlook says Disconnected at the bottom
Emails are stuck in Outbox
Outlook is not updating new messages

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Can you send and receive emails via Outlook Web App (outlook.office.com)?

options.label: Yes, webmail works fine (Desktop issue only)
No, webmail also fails to send/receive

troubleshooting_steps: Verify webmail access at outlook.office.com to isolate desktop client from mailbox server issue.
Restart Outlook in Safe Mode (`outlook.exe /safe`).
Rebuild corrupted local Outlook data file (`.ost`).

description: Cloud drive sync engine reporting file lock errors, duplicate conflict files, or red cross overlay on synced folders.
example_user_phrases: OneDrive says Sync Pending
File conflict error on shared folder
OneDrive red icon on file

diagnostic_questions.question_text: What specific sync icon is shown next to the file?

options.label: Red Circle with White Cross (Error / Lock)

troubleshooting_steps: Close file in desktop app to release local lock.
Reset OneDrive sync app (`%localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset`).
Check filename for unsupported special characters (`#`, `%`, `<`, `>`).

p2_conditions: Project team unable to access shared deliverables

description: Word, Excel, or PowerPoint displaying banner 'Unlicensed Product' or 'Subscription Cannot Be Verified'.
example_user_phrases: Excel says Unlicensed Product
Can't edit documents in Word
Office asks me to sign in repeatedly

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Does the app allow you to view files or is editing completely blocked?

troubleshooting_steps: Sign out of all accounts in Office app (File -> Account -> Sign Out) and restart app.
Run Microsoft Support and Recovery Assistant (SaRA) activation fix.
Clear cached identity credentials in Windows Credential Manager.

p2_conditions: Batch license revocation error across department

escalation_conditions: M365 Admin Center license pool exhausted

description: Workstation experiencing fatal system crash, screen hanging, system freeze, blue screen stop codes (BSOD), or unexpected kernel panics during operation.
example_user_phrases: Computer keeps crashing to a blue screen
Windows stop code CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED
Mac rebooted because of a problem kernel panic
My laptop screen is hanging
My laptop is completely frozen
My screen is frozen but mouse still moves
Laptop freezes when connected to docking station

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Is the entire laptop frozen, or can you still move the mouse/cursor?

options.label: Entire laptop is completely frozen (mouse and keyboard unresponsive)
Screen/app is frozen, but mouse cursor still moves
System crashes to blue screen / reboots

diagnostic_questions.question_text: When does the freeze or crash occur?

options.label: Randomly during heavy workload / video call
Only when connected to an external docking station

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Was a specific Windows Stop Code displayed on the blue screen?

troubleshooting_steps: Perform hard power reset (Hold power button for 30s).
Boot into Safe Mode and uninstall recently added display drivers or third-party antivirus.
Run Windows Memory Diagnostic tool (`mdsched.exe`) to test RAM modules.

p1_conditions: VIP primary laptop dead before investor call

description: Unable to print to corporate network printer, documents stuck in print queue spooler, or printer offline error.
example_user_phrases: Document stuck in printer queue
Printer says Offline
Print spooler service is not running

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Are other colleagues able to print to this network printer?

options.label: Yes, others can print fine (My PC issue)
No, printer display shows error or paper jam

troubleshooting_steps: Restart local Print Spooler service (`net stop spooler && net start spooler`).
Clear cached print job files from `%SystemRoot%\System32\Spool\Printers`.
Re-add printer via PaperCut / Enterprise Print Portal.

p1_conditions: Shipping warehouse primary label printer down
p2_conditions: Executive office printer jam during compliance audit

description: External monitors not detected when connected via USB-C / Thunderbolt docking station or display flickering.
example_user_phrases: External monitor is black when plugged into dock
Laptop won't charge through docking station
Second display keeps flickering

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Is the docking station charging the laptop power battery?

options.label: Yes, charging works but display is black
No, dock is completely unpowered (No lights)

troubleshooting_steps: Unplug dock power adapter from wall outlet for 10 seconds to reset dock internal chipset.
Update Thunderbolt / DisplayLink firmware drivers.
Test direct HDMI/DisplayPort cable bypass into laptop.

p2_conditions: Conference room main presentation display down

description: Laptop fan running continuously at maximum RPM, severe thermal throttling performance lag, or rapid battery battery drain.
example_user_phrases: Laptop fan is super loud and computer is burning hot
Battery drains from 100% to 0% in 30 minutes
System running extremely slow due to overheating

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Is there any visible physical swelling or bulging on the laptop casing/trackpad?

options.label: No physical swelling, just hot and fan loud

troubleshooting_steps: SAFETY CHECK: If battery shows physical swelling, shut down immediately and place in fire-safe area.
Check Activity Monitor / Task Manager for rogue process consuming 100% CPU.
Reset System Management Controller (SMC).

p2_conditions: Laptop shuts down repeatedly during work

escalation_conditions: Physical battery swelling (Mandatory immediate safety replacement)

description: User received suspicious email, clicked untrusted URL, executed unapproved file attachment, or suspects credential compromise.
example_user_phrases: I clicked a link in a suspicious email
I entered my password on a fake website
Antivirus popup warning about malware

diagnostic_questions.question_text: What action occurred after opening the suspicious email?

options.label: Only opened email body, took no action

troubleshooting_steps: SECURITY MANDATE: Disconnect device from Wi-Fi and ethernet immediately.
Initiate automated session revocation and password change.
Forward headers to phishing-report@enterprise.com for SOC analysis.

description: Fallback classification path for novel, ambiguous, or unmapped IT support requests ensuring non-dead-ending triage.
example_user_phrases: I have a general IT question
Need help with an unlisted problem
Can someone look at my computer

diagnostic_questions.question_text: Is this issue currently blocking your ability to work?

options.label: No, general question or non-blocking request

troubleshooting_steps: Gather detailed description of user request.
Route ticket to Tier 1 IT Service Desk for initial manual review.
Provide user with ticket reference number.
